top_signals.title: Guyana’s Oil Boom Could Ease the Global Supply Crunch
top_signals.summary: Tight global oil supplies, compounded by fears of further U.S. strikes against Iran, are stoking concerns over a potential oil price super-spike. Global petroleum inventories are shrinking, while U.S. fuel prices surge to historic highs, fueling inflation and intensifying pressure on the economy. As Middle East tensions disrupt shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for one-fifth of global oil supplies, Guyana’s petroleum output continues to expand, helping to mitigate supply constraints and the risk of significantly higher prices.…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Carlyle Shares Slump On Bigger-Than-Expected Drop in Fees
top_signals.summary: Carlyle Group Inc. shares fell the most in more than a year after the firm reported a bigger-than-expected drop in a key measure of earnings as a slew of exits left the firm with fewer fee-generating assets.

top_signals.summary: QatarEnergy is in talks for more long-term deals to buy liquefied natural gas from US companies, according to people familiar with the matter.
